status: draft, pending usability testing and legal review

decisions.decision: Notification channel, reasons, and pace are chosen by the user at journey setup. Cairn sends nothing else except confirmations of actions the user takes, and states where each confirmation will go before it is sent.
If the user makes no notification choice, the preference is 'in_app_only' and nothing is sent outside the app.
Pausing an active journey does not stop or extend the 28-day free period. Cairn tells the user this when they pause.
Closing, downloading, deleting, and changing notification preferences are always free, including when the account is read-only.

new_use_cases.title: Choose how and when Cairn keeps in touch
actors: User (surviving spouse, adult child or executor, power of attorney, or professional fiduciary)
new_use_cases.trigger: User reaches journey setup in UC-CASE-12 (step 3) or UC-CASE-18 for a second case.
preconditions: The journey has been shown to the user
main_flow: Cairn explains that the user decides how and how often Cairn keeps in touch, and that this can be changed any time.
Ask channel (multi-select): email, sms, push, in_app_only.
If any channel other than in_app_only: ask reasons (multi-select): due_date_upcoming, inactivity.
Ask timing: due_date lead time (1, 3, or 7 days) and inactivity threshold (3, 7, or 14 days) for each selected reason.
Ask maximum frequency: as_it_happens, daily_max, weekly_max.
Read back choices in plain language and confirm.

shortcut.label: Keep it simple for me
shortcut.status: draft values, open question on card 50

alternate_flows.name: skipped_or_in_app_only
alternate_flows.behavior: Store in_app_only. Nothing sent outside the app. Due dates and updates show in Cairn only.

alternate_flows.name: email
alternate_flows.behavior: Use the account email, shown masked for confirmation. Must work with Apple private email relay.

alternate_flows.name: push
alternate_flows.behavior: Show the OS permission prompt only after the user selects push. Never required for the app to work. Never promotional (Apple App Review Guideline 4.5.4).

alternate_flows.name: sms
alternate_flows.behavior: Collect mobile number just in time, verify with a one-time code, show consent line before first message.
flags: OPEN QUESTION card 50: SMS in MVP
LEGAL REVIEW: SMS consent wording and carrier registration

rules: Notification text is short and private. Never include the name of the person who died, the circumstance, or task details. Example: 'You have a step coming up in Cairn.'
Never send a notification the user did not choose, except action confirmations (UC-CASE-21).
Notification preferences are never used for marketing or advertising (UC-REG-07).
postconditions: notification_preferences row stored for this journey

rules: Turning notifications off never changes the journey itself.

new_use_cases.title: Confirmations for something the user just did
actors: User (surviving spouse, adult child or executor, power of attorney, or professional fiduciary)
new_use_cases.trigger: User completes an action that sends a confirmation. MVP: case deleted now, case deleted after 7-day hold, account deleted.
preconditions: User initiated the action in the app
main_flow: Before the user confirms the action, show where the confirmation will go (masked address).
After the action completes, send exactly one confirmation.
rules: Deletion confirmations go by email (decided 2026-09-25). Open question card 50: follow SMS or push preference instead?
Confirmation text is short, private, and never repeats deleted content.
The only notification type sent outside notification_preferences. Never used for anything else.
